subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “It taught the team that responsibility does not mean never being wrong.”?
options: It means taking the correction seriously.
Sometimes learning means adding names back to the story.
Sometimes it means changing the way something stays with us.
Borrowing something means bringing it back for the next person.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「It taught the team that responsibility does not mean never being wrong. It means taking the correction seriously.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Sometimes learning means adding names back to the story.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Sometimes it means changing the way something stays with us.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Borrowing something means bringing it back for the next person.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「It taught the team that responsibility does not mean never being wrong. It means taking the correction seriously.」，答案為「It means taking the correction seriously.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「It means taking the correction seriously.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
